items.question: Which iconographic marks define the golden vira-sri form?
items.inference: The verse enumerates the form's marks.
uncertainties: Token boundaries and sandhi are preserved as given.
Legacy glosses guide but are not authoritative.
items.plain_english: The right hand gives fearlessness, the left grants a boon; the thighs are lotus-petal shaped; this is the mark of the golden vira-sri form.
